sentences.text: The record's closest investigations to a lithium‑ion battery fire on the ISS are BASS‑II (PSI‑25), SAFFIRE‑I (PSI‑98), and SAFFIRE‑II (PSI‑99).
BASS‑II’s configuration uses thin PMMA films (0.1–0.4 mm) with opposed‑flow flame spread; O₂ match 1.00 (O₂ tested 15–22.2 %); flow match 0.90 (flow opposed at 0–10 cm/s).
SAFFIRE‑I’s configuration uses large SIBAL fabric (0.94 × 0.4 m) with concurrent flow 20 cm/s; O₂ match 0.96 (O₂ tested 21.5–21.7 %); flow match 0.90 (flow concurrent at 20 cm/s).
SAFFIRE‑II’s configuration uses silicone sheets (0.27–1.03 mm) with concurrent and opposed 20 cm/s; O₂ match 0.96 (O₂ tested 21.5–22.1 %); flow match 0.90 (flow concurrent; opposed at 20 cm/s).
The 55 tests that match the ISS cabin flammability limit come from PSI‑25 and PSI‑99.
